lamps.steady: Stays on for engine faults that increase emissions. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
Stays on if there is a fault in the Engine Management System. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
Indicates a problem with the key or system. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when the vehicle is immobilized because the key is not inserted.

lamps.steady: Indicates diesel pre-heating. Start the engine only after this light goes off.

lamps.flashing: Blinks with a buzzer to show the direction indicated by the turn signal.

lamps.steady: On when high beam headlights are switched on or flashed.
Indicates low engine oil pressure or electrical fault. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
Battery is not charging. Switch off electrical equipment and contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
Stays on to indicate an SRS malfunction. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center immediately.
lamps.flashing: Blinks when the SRS is malfunctioning. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center immediately.

lamps.lamp: Park Brake / Brake Fluid Low / EBD malfunction
lamps.steady: Indicates low brake fluid, active park brake, or ABS/EBD fault. Release park brake or check system.
Indicates that the cruise control system is activated.
Indicates a fault in the electric power steering. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center immediately.
Indicates engine overheating. Stop vehicle, turn off engine, let cool, and contact TATA MOTORS.
lamps.flashing: Blinks with a buzzer when engine overheats. Stop vehicle, turn off engine, and contact TATA MOTORS.

lamps.steady: DPF needs to clear pollutants. Drive at 50-80 kmph in 3rd gear above 2000 rpm for 20 minutes.
Fuel level is low. Refuel immediately to prevent engine stalling.
lamps.flashing: Blinks if there is a fault in the fuel system. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.

lamps.steady: Indicates an ABS malfunction. Normal brakes work without ABS. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center immediately.
Driver seatbelt is unbuckled. Fasten seatbelt to turn off the light.
lamps.flashing: Blinks with a buzzer when driver seatbelt is not buckled. Fasten seatbelt.

lamps.steady: Valid smart key is not detected inside the vehicle.

lamps.lamp: Press Clutch / Brake Pedal to Start Engine
lamps.steady: Press the clutch (or brake) pedal to start the engine.
Water in fuel filter or filter is clogged. Drain water immediately to avoid engine damage.
Daytime Running Lamps are on.
Indicates that a door or the tailgate is open. Close all doors.
Front passenger seatbelt is unbuckled. Fasten seatbelt to turn off.
lamps.flashing: Blinks with a buzzer when passenger seatbelt is not buckled. Fasten seatbelt.

lamps.steady: Economy drive mode is active for better fuel economy.
City drive mode is active for optimum torque and fuel economy.
Sport driving mode is active for increased engine torque.
Speed is above 80 kmph. Reduce speed below 75 kmph.
lamps.flashing: Flashes with beeps when speed exceeds 120 kmph. Reduce speed immediately.

lamps.steady: Fault in the Automated Manual Transmission. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center immediately.
Tire pressure is too high or low, temperature is high, or sensor is missing.
lamps.flashing: Blinks to warn of tire pressure/temp issues or system/sensor fault.

lamps.steady: Hill Descent Control system has a fault. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
Hill Descent Control system is activated.
Hill Hold Control system has a fault. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center.
ESP system has a fault. Contact TATA MOTORS authorized service center immediately.
